name: bblitec
description: Experimental Babylon Lite TypeScript-to-C++ transpiler and SDL3 native runtime.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/compiler.test.js dist/test/parity.test.js dist/test/upstream.test.js dist/test/asset-specializer.test.js dist/test/no-any.test.js
scripts.compile:example: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js examples/primitives.ts --out generated/primitives
scripts.compile:boombox: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js examples/boombox.ts --out generated/boombox --title "Babylon Lite Native - BoomBox"
